rules.rule: Check mode never changes code unless asked
must: Do not change code unless asked

rules.rule: Review judges by reading; no gofmt/vet/lint/test
must: do not run gofmt, go vet, golangci-lint, or go test

rules.rule: Style dimension delegated to go:style, not re-derived
must: do not re-derive style rules here

rules.rule: plan_first proposes then stops; broad targets default to plan-first
must: propose the budget and the package list, then stop for the user's answer
Default to plan-first: if the target is broad

rules.rule: State resolved target; empty diff falls back to the branch diff against base
must: State the resolved target and the exact package/file set before reviewing
diff it against the base branch

rules.rule: Fan-out workers get no cap share; cap applied once at the merge
must: Workers get no share of the cap
the cap is applied once at the merge

rules.rule: A defect that is both is reported once, under correctness
must: Report it once, under correctness, with the higher of its two grades

rules.rule: Never flag mandated style forms (segmented strings) as defects
must: never propose a backtick raw string for it

rules.rule: Correctness findings graded by a named input
must: one you cannot tie to an input is at most Should-fix

rules.rule: Cross-boundary claims verified with LSP, not asserted
Report names every command the pass ran
must: one line naming every command this pass ran

rules.rule: Applying fixes requires the fixing.md test gate; rule edits need confirmation
must: applying findings requires the test gate in `references/fixing.md`
never write a rule without confirmation
